button.label: Export logs
button.tooltip: Export a log bundle for this run

dialog.title: Export run logs
dialog.subtitle: Generate one redacted bundle you can download or report

action.report: Report as a comment attachment and @ the owner

state.idle_body: Pick a range, then choose "{{action}}". The server builds the bundle in one piece: structured logs, run metadata, and a summary you can paste into an AI chat.
state.collecting_body: Reading the structured transcript, run metadata, and the redacted summary.
state.partial_note: The server builds the bundle in one piece, so a failed export leaves no half-document to hand over. The last bundle that did finish is still here.
state.restored: This is the last bundle that finished.

card.truncated: Entry cap reached — this is the head of the transcript
card.redaction_incomplete: Redaction incomplete — do not forward as is
card.redaction_unknown: Redaction status unknown — do not forward as is

report.hint: Pushes to the workspace log repository first, leaving only a link in the comment; falls back to a comment attachment when the repository is unavailable.
report.success_git: Reported on {{issue}} — the bundle was pushed to {{repo}}.
report.success_attachment: Reported on {{issue}} — the bundle is a comment attachment.
report.fallback: Fell back to a comment attachment: {{reason}}
report.push_landed: Pushed to the log repository, but the comment did not send: {{reason}}

error.no_issue: This run is not linked to an issue, so it cannot be reported.
